_meta.description: STANDARD compressor calibration anchors – StudioLive 32SC, live simultaneous dump + UC Surface readback
_meta.displayReadbackMethod: UC Surface manual readback by user while dump was in progress
notes: All raw values are ZLIB scene-stored values extracted from the mixer dump.
Display values were read simultaneously from UC Surface (32SC Ch11 Fat Channel panel).
UC Control was NOT running during physical knob sweeps (live PV enabled on 32R; see parallel-probe evidence).
32SC comp.ratio ZLIB=1.0 is STALE from Phase 2 calibration probe write (not restored); display 1.9:1 reflects current physical knob position — raw↔display pair is NOT consistent for ratio.
comp.threshold K≈82 discrepancy with Phase 1 formula (K=56) is unresolved; new anchor supersedes Phase 1 data for threshold.

anchors.notes: Phase 1 used K=56 ('exact match'); this anchor requires K≈82. Phase 1 data suspected misread or wrong channel. 32R at raw=0→-56dB is consistent with K=56. May indicate 32SC vs 32R use different threshold floor ranges.

Phase 1 formula completely wrong. New formula derived from 2 cross-device data points: 32SC raw=0.190→21.8ms + 32R raw=1.0→150ms. Derived: 150*raw^1.161 ms. Phase 1 data (raw=0.190→1.37ms) is presumed misread or wrong parameter.
7.4% error is within Phase 2 calibration uncertainty. Formula approximately correct. 32R gives exact match at raw=0.720→384ms (see 32R fixture).
ZLIB raw=1.0 is from Phase 2 probe that wrote max ratio and failed to restore. Display=1.9:1 reflects current PHYSICAL knob position. Raw↔display pair is inconsistent. Do NOT use for calibration.
User did not read comp.gain display for 32SC during this session. 32R confirms formula at raw=0.315→8.82dB (see 32R fixture).
